responsibility: Implements the main MCore target backend logic behind the target hooks, RTL expansion helpers, and final assembly output decisions for this port. It owns frame-layout and prologue/epilogue generation, argument passing and return conventions, constant synthesis and cost modeling, address legitimacy and register-mode rules, trampoline emission, DLL import/export and naked-function attributes, section naming and symbol encoding, operand printing, libcall/assembler callbacks, and MCore-specific RTL transformations such as conditionalization and reorg support that complement the patterns in mcore.md.
same_name_distinction: Backend implementation file for the MCore port: it provides the C++ target-hook code, helper functions, and final asm callbacks that execute policies declared in mcore.h and work alongside the RTL patterns in mcore.md, rather than defining machine-description patterns or option tables.
